svg.text: Includes the contribution types shown on your public GitHub calendar.
17 public original repos · 36 followers · 5 repository stars
Push events may be incomplete or delayed (300-event cap); repository push dates are shown if none return.
Commits: indexed author matches. Commit counts and contribution-calendar totals measure different things.
Sources: GitHub public calendar, Events API and Commit Search API. Refreshed daily.
